description: Scenarios of the reference controller suites that need a real Docker engine. The source files in source/ are verbatim snapshots of the reference consumer project's tests (data, not executable tests). These scenarios are NOT verified by npm test: they belong to the Docker integration task, which creates test/integration/ for them. A 'portable' entry names the portable test (ralph/<file>.test.js) that covers the part that does not need a container; it does not stand in for the container assertions.

cases.test: sandboxed agent receives only explicit credentials
assertions: inside the container only the explicit credential is set, no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN
the operator home is not mounted
cases.portable: ralph/agent.test.js "supports both explicit sandbox credential types"

cases.test: timed out sandboxed agent stops its container
assertions: a timed out agent container no longer exists
cases.portable: ralph/agent.test.js "a timed out agent stops its container"

cases.test: finished sandboxed agent leaves no container
assertions: a background process left by the agent does not keep its container alive

cases.test: controller exit stops active agent containers
assertions: exit and SIGINT of the controller remove every running agent container

cases.test: sandboxed agent cannot write .git (no fsmonitor or hooks for host git)
assertions: git config and hooks in the mounted .git cannot be written

cases.test: runProjectGate runs inside sandbox without network
assertions: each gate command runs in a container whose only interface is loopback
cases.portable: ralph/core.test.js "always applies sandbox policy to executable phases"

assertions: install runs in a container through the proxy with the install env
dependency sync updates the lock file in the clone
cases.portable: ralph/workspace.test.js "runs profile dependency sync for changed manifest"

cases.test: a failed sandbox install keeps its full output in a log named in the error
assertions: the package manager's real error is in the log named by the failure
cases.portable: ralph/workspace.test.js "dependency sync failure blocks before final gate"

cases.test: a gate check cannot plant anything in .git
assertions: a gate command cannot write a hook into the clone's .git
containers and networks with this consumer's label are removed at startup
cases.portable: ralph/run.test.js "uses local runs root for consumer state"

assertions: unlabelled containers and containers of another consumer keep running
